probes.name: value_of_empty_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:B2").Value
Probe = TypeName(v) & "|" & UBound(v, 1) & UBound(v, 2) & "|" & IsEmpty(v(2, 2))
End Function

probes.name: value_past_used_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:C3").Value
Probe = UBound(v, 1) & UBound(v, 2) & "|" & v(1, 1) & "|" & IsEmpty(v(3, 3)) & "|" & UBound(ws.Range("D5:E6").Value, 1)
End Function

probes.name: value_error_cells
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1/0"
ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=NA()"
Dim v
v = ws.Range("A1:A2").Value
Probe = IsError(v(1, 1)) & "|" & CStr(v(1, 1)) & "|" & (v(2, 1) = CVErr(xlErrNA)) & "|" & ws.Range("A1").Text
End Function

probes.name: listrow_range_item
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = 1
Dim lo As ListObject
Set lo = ws.ListObjects.Add(xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B2"), , xlYes)
Dim r As ListRow
Set r = lo.ListRows.Add
r.Range(1, 2).Value = "c"
Probe = lo.ListRows.Count & "|" & r.Range(1, 2).Address & "|" & ws.Range("B3").Value
End Function

probes.name: match_not_found
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = 1
Dim v
v = Application.Match("zz", ws.Range("A1:A3"), 0)
Probe = IsError(v) & "|" & (v = CVErr(xlErrNA)) & "|" & TypeName(v)
End Function

probes.name: resize_past_the_sheet
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
On Error Resume Next
On Error Resume Next
Dim r As Range, s As String
Set r = ws.Range("A1048576").Resize(2)
s = Err.Number & ";"
Err.Clear
Set r = ws.Range("XFD1").Resize(1, 2)
s = s & Err.Number & ";"
Err.Clear
Set r = ws.Range("A1048575").Resize(2)
s = s & Err.Number & r.Address
Probe = s
End Function
